recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the already-applied FHIR-17069 correction without changing approved semantics; any broader rewrite of Bundle.entry.response.outcome should wait for a final separate issue decision such as FHIR-53053.
issue_request: FHIR-17069 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 correction for FHIR-core Bundle.entry.response. It asked to replace copied request-processing wording with text describing the results of the corresponding request in batch/transaction responses and result information when returning history.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 14404 and preserved in Git commit 5fe1b30f925aa52214da30dfc72fd38bc8d79e36 (GF#17069 - fix definition), which changed the old Bundle spreadsheet definition. The current migrated source contained the intended response/history definition but retained the malformed phrase 'where when returning history'.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active bundle=Bundle resource entry, placing source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml in current build scope. Related later issues FHIR-17075, FHIR-19619, and FHIR-32011 refine adjacent history/request/response behavior but do not supersede this top-level definition. FHIR-53053 is Triaged and concerns Bundle.entry.response.outcome, so it is not final source-edit scope. Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary evidence for the malformed phrase.
reconciliation: Changed 'where when' to 'were when' in the authoritative Bundle StructureDefinition definition and in the matching checked-in Bundle SVG title for Bundle.entry.response. Historical tools/history release snapshots were not edited.
source_changes: source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml: corrected Bundle.entry.response definition from 'where when returning history' to 'were when returning history'.
source/bundle/bundle.svg: corrected the matching Bundle.entry.response diagram title so active rendered hover text stays consistent.
